title: Can AI Chat Replace Traditional Search? Evidence from a RAG-based Live Events Experiment
abstract: arXiv:2610.28639v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Conversational AI tools are being increasingly integrated into online search and browsing interfaces. To understand how such tools affect user behavior and search outcomes, we run a pre-registered, incentivized online experiment in which participants search a catalog of several thousand events scraped from a major live-events platform. We compare three interfaces: a classic, attribute-based filter interface (Filter), a GenAI chat interface (Chat), and a combined interface offering both (Hybrid). In both AI conditions, AI output is restricted via retrieval-augmented generation (RAG). Our main result is that, relative to the other two conditions, the Chat condition performs the worst. The effect is robust across AI models (gpt-4.1-mini, gpt-5.2 and gpt-5.4) and is driven mainly by users who perform open-ended exploration (as opposed to users searching for a specific artist, venue or sports team). translated_title: AI聊天能否取代传统搜索？来自基于RAG的现场活动实验的证据
translated_abstract: 对话式AI工具正被越来越多地整合到在线搜索和浏览界面中。为了解此类工具如何影响用户行为和搜索结果，我们开展了一项预注册的、有激励机制的在线实验，参与者在从某大型现场活动平台抓取的数千个活动目录中进行搜索。我们比较了三种界面：经典的基于属性筛选的界面、生成式AI聊天界面以及两者兼备的混合界面。在两种AI条件中，AI输出均通过检索增强生成（RAG）进行限制。我们的主要结果是：相对于另外两种条件，聊天条件的表现最差。该效应在不同AI模型（gpt-4.1-mini、gpt-5.2和gpt-5.4）下均保持稳健，且主要由进行开放式探索的用户（相对于搜索特定歌手、场馆或运动队的用户）所驱动。此外，没有显著的差异……
tldr: 通过一项预注册的现场活动搜索实验发现，基于RAG的纯AI聊天界面搜索表现最差，尤其在开放式探索场景中，表明生成式AI对话界面尚不能取代传统搜索方式。
en_tdlr: A pre-registered live-events search experiment shows that a RAG-based GenAI chat interface performs worst compared to traditional filter and hybrid interfaces, especially for open-ended exploration, suggesting AI chat cannot yet replace traditional search.
